name: Mori no Monogatari
source:
Ten's grandmother is sick and she's asked to visit her. Will she be able to visit her grandmother safely?

[From [URL=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=16927]Lemma Soft Forums[/URL]]
translation:
天的祖母生病了，她被要求去探望祖母。她能平安地见到祖母吗？

[来自[URL=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=16927]Lemma Soft Forums[/URL]]
